meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与参考图对比，并检查设计系统、功能正确性和文字显示，最终给出“通过”或“不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了网页界面或终端界面，并询问界面是否看起来正确时触发。也适用于怀疑界面出现回归问题或文字显示异常时。

say.text: 检查我刚改好的这个页面布局对不对。
看看这个终端界面的边框有没有对齐。
say.note: Claude 会检查终端界面的文本对齐和边框绘制。

say.text: 这个组件的中文文字有没有被截断？
say.note: Claude 会检查 CJK 文字是否显示完整。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA on any UI you build or modify. It captures screenshots, compares them with references, and checks design system, functionality, and text rendering, then outputs a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you build or change any web or terminal UI, or when asked if a page, component, or TUI looks right. Also used when you suspect a regression or text display issue.

say_en.text: Check the layout of this page I just modified.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the screenshot, compare with reference, and report findings.

say_en.text: Check if the borders of this terminal UI are aligned.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect text alignment and box-drawing in the terminal.

say_en.text: Is any Chinese text clipped in this component?
say_en.note: Claude will check for CJK text clipping or misalignment.
